feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Robert Pattinson confirmed as new James Bond
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson has been confirmed as the new James Bond.

articles.title: AI child sex abuse images 'soar 8,400% in two years'
articles.summary: The amount of child sex abuse images and videos generated using AI is 85 times higher than just two years ago, scientists discovered.

articles.title: Snow warning for large part of the UK
articles.summary: A yellow warning for snow and travel disruption has been issued across a large part of the UK by the Met Office.

articles.title: Man charged after two killed in police chase collision
articles.summary: A man has been charged with causing death by dangerous driving after two people were killed when a car being chased by police collided with their vehicle.

articles.title: British women convicted of illegal abortions under Victorian-era law to receive automatic pardons
articles.summary: Women who were convicted or cautioned for illegal abortions will be automatically pardoned under a law change.

articles.title: Government accused of 'complacency' over 'catastrophic' security risks to UK
articles.summary: Andy Burnham's government appears "complacent" about the potential for "catastrophic risks" to the UK - and the country is underprepared, an influential committee of peers has warned.

articles.title: PM to say 'Brexit hasn't worked' and set out conditions for future EU deal in major speech
articles.summary: The prime minister will call for a reset of Britain's relationship with Europe ahead of Friday's UK-EU summit - and assert that "the Brexit we were given has not worked".

articles.title: England hang on to beat world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid thriller
articles.summary: A 10-man England hung on to beat world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid to top their Nations League group.
